theme: Four-unit fish tablets, source identities and competing physical readings
question: Which tablets form H-912's number-V-fish series, and do graphic probabilities or independently linked containers, quantities and fish remains distinguish literal contents from a standard allocation, recipient or designation?
outcome: Recovered H-302, H-912, H-1191 and H-1192: three four-V-fish forms and one four-fish-V form, all with fish-bearing longer legends. The reserved three entries collapse to two whole-carrier prototypes in one dependency component. A fixed-four prediction gains 1.99159 bits over pooled non-fish values and 0.55367 bits over the stroke-conditioned reference, with exact p=0.5 and failed minimum eight for both. A fixed four-unit allocation has identical graphic likelihood. The broad register retains 767 provisional objects and 1350 faces, with 392 basic-data and 390 image joins. The separate primary excavation audit recovers a 4-7-foot range across two squares and three months, not an object-specific measured 5.5-foot depth, and no direct container or fish-assemblage join. Forty-seven author arithmetic and source-integrity checks pass.
challenge: The corpus and fish-number family were already examined. Copied three-sign texts share dependency components. H-912 and H-1191 have identical transcriptions and a shared mixed source reference, without held photographs for H-1191 or H-1192. The registration prefix is a broad collection series; suffixes mix FC tails and catalogue references. Source proximity is weaker than a physical contents link. Long-stroke vessel estimates do not calibrate the tablet's short strokes.
remedy: Preserved all faces, source namespaces, missing photographs and prior failed results; used a private spending-ledger copy and one shared-loader confirmation read after freezing. Recorded calibrated label testing as infeasible on discovery. Scored the strongest fixed-quota rival rather than only an unconstrained quantity reference. Kept the existing literal reading at 0.35 and a post-outcome category-and-denomination proposal at 0.40 with prospective kill conditions. Downloaded witnesses and record-level joins remain local.
retry_when: An individually registered new tablet has a physical container, measured allotment, content or use association; an external correspondence identifies the item or unit; or checked CISI 3 plates resolve the H-1191/H-912 identity question and H-1192's physical faces. Freeze exact short-stroke/plain-V/plain-fish membership and unit calibration before a new quantity score. Another split of the same copies supplies no new population.
